angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 650,480 km at 141.01 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.0918 +/- 0.0179 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 141.01 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.935 +/- 0.023 solar radii from Močnik et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-85 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..150M/abstract): 650,480 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.09 +/- 0.08 solar masses from Močnik et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-85 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..150M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6112 +/- 27 K from Močnik et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-85 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..150M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Močnik et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-85 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..150M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-85-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.534, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-85 A (pscomppars): spectral type G5 V, from Močnik et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..150M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+07 2474A: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-85 A (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.118 dex, from Kokori et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022ApJS..258...40K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-85 A (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.07144, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3909745223886018432, flags_flame 00: age_flame 3.9546297 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 2.9541388 to 4.9522033)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-85 A (pscomppars): rotation period 15.1 d, from Močnik et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....151..150M/abstract)

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.935 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.868. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.
